items.label: roles
items.needle: The coordinator prepares the release; the inspector verifies it; the duty lead approves exceptions.

items.label: prerequisites
items.needle: Use the current manifest and verify that the check gate is staffed before starting.

items.label: step 1
items.needle: 1. Check the manifest against the parcel count and record any mismatch.

items.label: step 2
items.needle: 2. Test the release signal with the inspector present; retain the timestamp.

items.label: step 3
items.needle: 3. Release only after both checks pass and tell the coordinator the batch number.

items.label: warning
items.needle: Warning: stop immediately if the signal lamp is red. Never bypass the test gate.

items.label: figure caption
items.needle: Figure 1. Gate order: check, test, then release; each gate must pass before the next.

items.label: exception
items.needle: If the inspector is unavailable, keep the batch waiting and ask the duty lead for a replacement.

items.label: protocol reference
items.needle: [1] Harbor Lab. Handoff protocol, synthetic edition, 2026, sections 2-3.

items.label: record requirement
items.needle: Record the batch number, all three gate timestamps, and the name of the approving lead.
